requestedScope: All current and future saved brands/topics, weekly India briefings; individual pause is preserved by routine synchronization.

writer.authentication: Google-signed RS256 OIDC token with the configured service-account email and exact audience. Sites service access and the old private-deployment flag grant no writer access.

scheduler.purpose: Hourly due-rule dispatcher; each brand rule still runs weekly. Existing paused Sites automation must remain paused to avoid redundant dispatchers.
scheduler.activation: Keep MONITOR_SCHEDULER_ACTIVE false until the actual cloud job is created, enabled, executed and its authenticated HTTP result verified. Do not treat this file as evidence of activation.

execution.costs: Every launched scan consumes the existing report allowance and provider usage. Quotas are enforced for unattended work.
execution.retries: A unique owner/monitor/due reservation prevents repeated paid launches after lost acknowledgements or expired leases. An unknown provider launch outcome is retained as a failed/interrupted report rather than relaunched automatically. Quota/pre-reservation failures back off one hour.
execution.cadence: First scan due immediately. Preserve the UTC cadence anchor, skip missed periods, clamp short months and restore the original month-day later. Runner interval can delay starts by up to one hour plus retries.
execution.completion: Existing signed OpenAI background webhooks persist completed reports. The scheduler also refreshes pending reports as a fallback; refresh failures return HTTP 503 for retry.
execution.notifications: Results and errors appear in the workspace. Monitoring does not send email or access connected social/ad/panel providers.

validation.realProvider: One completed report with two official Google documentation sources in an isolated local D1 database; duplicate and pause behavior checked without modifying production owners or quotas.
validation.cloudStatusAtImplementation: Verified: an authenticated Google Cloud Scheduler force-run launched a due monitoring rule, the signed OpenAI webhook saved its completed cited report, and the rule advanced one week. QA rule paused after the test. MONITOR_SCHEDULER_ACTIVE enabled only after this proof.

rollback: Pause the Google Cloud job first, disable all-brand monitoring in the workspace, and leave the old Sites task paused. Source can revert while retaining additive nullable/defaulted schema columns; do not remove user reports.
